payload.name: Coeurl Whisper
payload.description: Spawns a line of dragon heads that slowly move across the arena, with some gaps between them (similar to Kugane Ohashi or The Vault's horses). They deal damage and inflict a Vulnerability Up stack on players they pass through. Watch out for and weave between the gaps to avoid them. In the next phase, two perpendicular lines will spawn instead, each only having dragons in one half of the line. They will cross each other during Rhalgr's Piece, leaving only one corner of the arena safely free of dragons. If your party's damage is low, in the next phase, you will also see a line of dragon heads with a tiny gap, paired with The Rose of Destruction, requiring your party to stack together while also aligned with the gap, letting the dragons safely pass around you.
